common.genericError: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed — please try again.
common.networkError: We can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
common.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do this.

roleShort.noneTitle: The role is set once the item is approved

noAccess.title: You don’t have access to this section
noAccess.body: The item bank and taxonomy are open to item authors, reviewers and the bank editor only. If you need a role, ask an administrator.

list.title: Item bank
list.subtitle: {written} items written in season {season}, {approved} approved. Frozen versions are never edited — every change becomes a new version.
list.subtitleNoSeason: There is no active season. Frozen versions are never edited — every change becomes a new version.
list.subtitleMine: The items you have written. A submitted version is frozen — the next change becomes a new version.

tiles.seasonSub: Allowing for rejection at review, we write about {w}. {written} written so far.
tiles.rejBody: {rejected} of {decided}. 30–40% is a normal rate, not a failure — the plan is built around it.
tiles.tileAria: Grade {g}: {a} approved, {c} accepted, {r} in review, {d} draft, target {n}
tiles.lgNote: Bar length is relative to the season target
tiles.targetsInvalid: Each target must be a whole number from 0 to 5000.
tiles.noSeason: There is no active season — targets can’t be saved.

table.label: Item list
table.author: AUTHOR
table.flagLegend: Flags: p outside 0.20–0.85 · discrimination below 0.20 · a distractor almost nobody picks · uz and ru versions behave differently (DIF). Statistics appear after the first calibration. Anchors never enter practice.

empty.title: No items match these filters
empty.body: Pick another grade, status or role — or clear the filters to see the whole bank.
empty.bankBody: At the start of a season the bank is empty — write the first item. Start with anchors: together they must span the form’s full difficulty range.
empty.mineBody: You haven’t written any items yet. The first one follows the template: grade, topic, construct, the stem in uz and ru, options, and a misconception code for every wrong option.

error.title: We couldn’t load the item bank
error.body: The server didn’t respond. No items or versions were changed, and drafts are safe on the server. Try again in a minute.

tax.title: Taxonomy
tax.subtitle: The vocabulary that items, reports and the practice builder speak: topics, skills and misconceptions.
tax.rule: Codes never change, and nothing used by an item is ever deleted — a misconception is retired instead.
tax.readOnly: You can read the taxonomy. Changes are made by the bank editor.
tax.topicsEmpty: No topics in this cluster yet.
tax.addTopicSub: The code starts with the cluster prefix: num. — numeracy, rea. — reasoning, lan. — language. It can’t be changed later.
tax.topicCodeHint: For example {p}fractions — lowercase Latin letters, digits and _.
tax.skillsNote: Skills are for grades 0–2 only: younger children are reported skill by skill.
tax.skillCodeHint: For example s.addsub.10 — starts with s.
tax.misNote: Every wrong option carries a misconception code. Parents see the explanation — write it in plain words.
tax.misCodeHint: For example m.borrow.skip — starts with m.

errors.exists: That code already exists. Codes are never reused.
errors.in_use: Items or skills sit outside that grade range — it can’t be narrowed like this.
errors.grade_range: The grade range is wrong: “from” can’t exceed “to”, and a skill’s grade must lie within its topic’s range.
errors.cluster_mismatch: The code prefix doesn’t match the cluster: num. — numeracy, rea. — reasoning, lan. — language.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid: check the code format and the names.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That entry no longer exists — the page has been refreshed.
